gate_a_to_d.a_what_a_token_is: In layout='trader': one token per trader i in {0..N-1} produced by aggbench.transformer.full_context ([obs_i (NaN->0), obs_present_mask_i, own_sensor_model_i, provenance_key_i at visibility, report_logit_i / 4]). In layout in {'grid', 'axial', 'grid_full'}: one cell token per (trader r, piece rank t) produced by aggbench.trader_transformer.piece_tokens ([present, obs_k, own_cov_k, own_mu_k, key_cov_k, key_mu_k]).
gate_a_to_d.b_what_a_layer_is: Pre-norm Transformer layer in TraderNet: LayerNorm -> causal Cross-Trader Self-Attention (or GRUCell in token_state='recurrent', or Feedback memory attention in token_state='feedback', active on attn_layers) -> residual + LayerNorm -> 2-layer GELU MLP (width -> 4*width -> width) -> residual.
gate_a_to_d.c_what_crosses_between_traders_and_width: Full d_model = 128 (layout='trader') or 64 (layout='grid*') hidden state vectors cross between traders via causal self-attention K/V states, GRU recurrent state s_t, or Feedback memory.
gate_a_to_d.d_regret_bars_and_alignment: Evaluated on alignment='unaligned' dev splits (n_eval=2000, test untouched) against exact Bayes (0.0000), oracle_clearing, extremized_log_pool, and FullContextTransformer across 3 seeds with 95% bootstrap CIs and untrained_init + random_network controls.
